name: Expected Value Theory
description: Synthetic experiment runner implementing Expected Value Theory for decision-making under risk, modeling choices between probabilistic options.

parameters.name: choice_temperature
parameters.description: Softmax temperature parameter controlling choice stochasticity (lower = more deterministic).

parameters.name: value_lambda
parameters.description: Scaling factor applied to option values.

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Number of discrete points in the allowed values range.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: DataFrame with values and probabilities for options A and B.

outputDataType.name: observations
outputDataType.description: DataFrame with probability of choosing option A as dependent variable.
